subject: The Deal Decision Pack (and the rest of Pro)
preheader: PDF export, BRRRR, 10-year projections, deal compare.
headline: You're underwriting deals — here's what Pro adds when one gets serious.
body: You've been running deals on TrueCap — nice. When a deal gets real, Pro is what turns the analysis into something you can act on and share.

It adds the one-click Deal Decision Pack PDF, the BRRRR and fix-and-flip analyzers, 10-year projections, illustrative tax impact and modeled exit comparisons, the sensitivity grid and max-offer solver, editing and unlimited saved deals with side-by-side compare — plus every deal pass/failed against YOUR buy box, so the verdict is graded on your criteria, not generic ones.
Pro is $29.99/mo, month-to-month, cancel anytime — and your saved deals never leave your account. Most people run free for a while, then upgrade the first time a deal is worth a lender packet.
